definitions.explanation: Describes a surface with many bumps or dents.
Describes being thoroughly beaten or defeated.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぼこぼこだ。
⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼこぼこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦へこんでいる→へこむ：00097_hekomu⟧。
examples.english: The car is full of dents.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぼこぼこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I got completely beaten in the game.

examples.japanese: ぼこぼこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{転|ころ}びそうになった→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧。
examples.english: I almost tripped on the bumpy ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぼこぼこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やられた→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: I got totally beaten in the match.

examples.japanese: ぼこぼこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{殴|なぐ}られた→殴る：02378_naguru⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボンネット→ボンネット：28602_bonnetto⟧。
examples.english: The car hood that was battered full of dents.

notes:
ぼこぼこ is an onomatopoeic word describing surfaces with many bumps or dents, and by extension, being badly beaten.

SENSE 1 — BUMPY/DENTED:
Describes a surface full of bumps, holes, or dents.
- ぼこぼこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: a bumpy road
- ぼこぼこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦へこむ→へこむ：00097_hekomu⟧: to be dented all over
- ⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼこぼこだ: the ground is uneven

SENSE 2 — BEATEN BADLY:
Colloquial. Describes being thoroughly defeated or physically beaten.
- ぼこぼこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to beat up badly, to thrash
- ぼこぼこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to get beaten badly (passive)
- ぼこぼこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やられた→やる：02980_yaru⟧: got totally destroyed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦でこぼこ→でこぼこ：04547_dekoboko⟧: uneven, bumpy (neutral, no violent connotation; often describes terrain)
- ⟦ぼろぼろ→ぼろぼろ：05164_boroboro⟧: worn out, tattered, falling apart (describes deterioration over time)
- ⟦ぐちゃぐちゃ→ぐちゃぐちゃ：05170_guchagucha⟧: messy, crushed (emphasizes shapelessness)

REGISTER:
Both senses are informal/colloquial. The "beaten up" sense is particularly casual and common among younger speakers.
